item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Omar looks at the diagram of triangle $DEF$. Segment $EH$ meets side $DF$ at $H$, and the right-angle mark at $H$ is shown. Point $M$ is the midpoint of $DF$.

Which claim correctly names $EH$?

options.A: $EH$ is an altitude from $E$ to base $DF$, because it is perpendicular to $DF$.
options.B: Call $EH$ an altitude even when $EH$ need not be perpendicular to $DF$.
options.C: Say the same segment also settles the area formula for every triangle, with no further check.
options.D: Name $EH$ an altitude because $M$ is labelled on $DF$, using the midpoint mark alone.
